_note: What you see: The widget App/link tile in the Add widget window, kind Tiles and links: there is no separate Add tiles button or window any more. The form opens with the choice An app or A link; here An app is chosen and Case system is ticked, with the app icon and the count of new items. The list Pick the app holds the Nextcloud apps, the IT app catalogue (with requests to IT), services running on the server and the ready-made Office tiles; importing bookmarks sits below it, every folder becomes a Container with link tiles. On the right Appearance: preview of the tile, tile colour from eight theme colours, text colour (title, count and icon) from the theme plus white and black with white by default, the contrast check against WCAG AA (here 5.6:1, passes), what is on the tile, pin, and the rule that default tiles show the white logo on the brand colour, without payoff.
